Beacon Mod test plan

Mod: Beacon Mod Version: 0.1.0 Zip: BeaconMod-0.1.0.zip

This plan tests Beacon Mod 0.1.0, a made-up example mod. Start with the smoke test.

Before you start

  1. Install BeaconMod-0.1.0.zip with your mod manager and enable it.
  2. Turn on Papyrus logging.

Smoke test

  • Start a new game and finish the character creator.
    Expect: no error message about Beacon Mod.
  • Open Settings > Gameplay.
    Expect: a "Beacon" group with "Show Debug Messages (PC only)", off by default.
  • Open the console and type player.additem 0001A2B3 1.
    Expect: one Beacon in your inventory.
  • Drop the beacon and activate it.
    Expect: the message "Beacon placed." and a light on the ground.
Deep checks (optional)

2 Main feature

  • Pick the beacon up again.
    Expect: it goes back to your inventory.
    Try it in a building too; the mod page says it works indoors.

3 Save and load

  • Save, quit to the main menu and load the save. A long unbroken command for the phone-width test: player.additem 0001A2B3 1000000000000000000000000000000
    Expect: a placed beacon is still there.
